_comment: Draft copy, not final — Rev A's original content spec isn't in this project folder, so this was written fresh (see Engineering-Log.md). Replace [NAME], [GROOM], and [DATE] with real facts; edit the rest freely, it's a starting point, not locked copy. Keep serials in sync with firmware/config.h's Personalization::SERIAL_NUMBER for each unit. Site reads ?unit=LPE-GM-001 from the URL and looks it up here.

LPE-GM-001.name: [NAME]
objectives: Report for duty on [DATE] — full mission briefing at check-in.
Secure the groom's suit, rings, and general composure. In that order.
Deliver the best man speech. Keep it under control; keep it real.
Stand beside [GROOM] at the altar. This is the actual mission.
LPE-GM-001.hiddenMessage: SERVICE LOG — This unit was custom-built by [GROOM] for one reason: you've always shown up when it counted. Every objective on this screen is real — [DATE], for real. Thanks for saying yes to standing up there with me. — [GROOM]
